 Sunil Nayak .... Petitioner

entities.text: High Court Of Orissa At Cuttack
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Mr. D.P. Dhal, Sr.Advocate

-versus-
 State of Odisha and another .... Opposite Parties
Mr. P.K. Maharaj, Asc

Coram: Justice V. Narasingh
 Order
Learned counsel for the State, on instruction, submits that notice has been served on the informant/victim on 12.08.2023 indicating therein that the matter shall be taken up on today (18.08.2023).
There is no appearance on behalf of the informant/victim when the matter is called.
2. Memo of appearance filed by learned Senior Counsel Mr. D.P. Dhal on behalf of the petitioner is taken on record.

3. Heard learned Senior Counsel for the petitioner and learned counsel for the State.
4.

The petitioner is an accused in connection with Special POCSO Case No.49 of 2023, pending in the file of learned ADJ-cum- Special Court under POCSO Act, Angul, arising out of Athamallik P.S.
Case No.135 of 2023 for alleged commission of offences under Sections 363/366/376(2)(n)/376(3)
of IPC read with Section 4(2)/6(1) of POCSO Act.

5. Being aggrieved by the rejection of his application for bail U/s.439 Cr.P.C. by the learned A.D.J.-cum-Special Court under POCSO Act, Angul by order dated 27.06.2023 in the aforementioned case, the present BLAPL has been filed.
6. It is submitted that the petitioner is in custody since 16.06.2023 and as charge sheet has been filed on 11.08.2023, further continuance of the petitioner in custody is not warranted.

sentences.text: 7. Learned counsel for the State opposes the prayer for bail.

8. Perused the 164 Cr.P.C. statement of the victim.
9.

Considering the tenor thereof and taking into account the filing of charge sheet and period of custody, this Court directs the petitioner to be released on bail on such terms to be fixed by the learned Court in seisin.
10. Accordingly, the BLAPL stands disposed of.
11. Urgent certified copy of this order be granted as per rules.
(V. NARASINGH)
